applyTo: "src/EncDotNet.S57/**,tests/**/S57*.cs"

# S-57 editing rules

When modifying `EncDotNet.S57`:

- Load the `s57-enc` skill before proposing non-trivial changes, and read the
  relevant `standards/md/S57v31*.md` section.
- This is a published package that EncDotNet.S100 uses to translate S-57 to
  S-101. Treat public API changes as breaking; say so in the PR description.
- Decode fields through `EncDotNet.Iso8211`; do not re-implement subfield
  parsing.
- Use `S57FieldTags`, `S57SubfieldNames` and `S57ObjectCode` instead of
  literals. Parsed data stays immutable.
- Keep coordinates as COMF/SOMF-scaled integers inside the model; convert at
  the boundary.
- Cite the S-57 clause in XML doc comments for spec-derived types, constants
  and enum values.
